request: Build a small Jac web app where people share memories. A memory has a creator name, a title, a message and a list of tags. Readers can like a memory, the author can edit or delete it, and the feed can be searched by title or by tag. Keep the memory rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: A memory needs a non-empty creator and title; tags are stored without duplicates.
Liking a memory increases its like count by one.
Searching by a tag returns only memories that carry that tag; searching by text matches titles case-insensitively.
Deleting a memory removes it from the feed.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
